title: Multiple recurring hill dreams, I've never made it to the top though
content: This recurring dream about a lone road going up an impossibly steep hill, goes back to when I was a child, so like 40+ years ago. These pictures are not mine, but are very very close to the angle and feeling of steepness. Most of the time there are no houses around, its very rural and run down looking. It is always a feeling of urgency in the dream to get to the top of the hill. The first time was a dirt hill and I was running up it. It became vertical at a point and I scrambled to make it to the top, grabbing roots, but slid down and fell backwards. Woke up before I hit the "ground". Second time I was a few years older (in real life) and now riding a bicycle (in the dream) up a still dirt road. Same thing, got to a vertical point and I remember furiously pumping my bike pedals, changing gears and spinning my wheels going nowhere. I didn't slide backwards, I fell backwards and woke up as I hit the ground. I woke up gasping and sweating. Couple more dreams on bikes in the next few years but now the road is paved, i wake up at the point of impact from falling. In my early 20s I had the dream, but now I'm driving a car up a paved road. Gets almost vertical. No matter how much I push the accelerator or shift gears, it was just too steep and I was just spinning wheels. Car spun to the left and it falls, woke up before the ground. After over 20 years since the last one, I had another one last year. It was a twist turny freeway world in the middle of a huge bustling city, roads going through buildings, weird stuff. I was hitching a ride (why? I dunno) and two girls in a saab picked me up. They took a highway out of the city and said the road would go where I was asking to go. It wound around and starting going up a steep hill. The girls looked at each other nervously and said "we'll get there!". But eventually it got too steep, the car started to slide and the driver looked at me in a panic and pushed me out the car door, yelling that I had to go, they couldn't make it. It was too steep to stand and I held onto a lamppost, dangling, then I dropped. Woke up before hitting the ground. Sorry so long, I just found this sub and I got excited I might not be the only one whose seen this hill.
